771150301.text: Hey! Where the hell did you two drop in from? You ain't here to swipe our loot, are ya!?

771150303.text: I don't remember askin' for two little runts for the job... You two think "The Anvil" is a pushover, huh??? I'll show you what I'm made of!

771150305.text: Hmph! You two punks still wanna talk back? Time for "The Anvil" to teach ya some manners!

771150501.text: Hey! Where the hell did you two drop in from? You ain't here to swipe our loot, are ya!?

771150503.text: You kiddin' me! Nobody just "passes by" around here! You think "The Anvil" is an idiot, huh??? I'll show you what I'm made of!

771150505.text: Hmph! You two punks still wanna talk back? Time for "The Anvil" to teach ya some manners!

771150601.text: I'm sorry! I'm sorry, you two! I screwed up, alright? I didn't know who I was messin' with!

771150602.text: #Hey, hey, hey — so now you're begging for mercy after doing something bad, huh? Get him good, {NICKNAME}!

771150604.text: Wait, stop, stop!!! I can pay ya! I got cash...

771150605.text: You see that tunnel over there? That's how we snuck into town... and that's where our stash is right now. All the loot we swiped from Okurov is inside.

771150606.text: But hey... obviously, all that stuff's yours now.

771150608.text: Although what? You're not trying to go back on your word, are you???

771150609.text: Naw, naw, naw, no one's backin' out of nothing, man! It's just... the tunnel entrance is all caved in. I can't get in there, and neither can you.

771150610.text: Took me a whole lot of wrangling just to get this naive little punk to help me, and then I went and got the dynamite all ready according to his little plan.

771150611.text: But he kept dragging his feet, while me and my boys were about to freeze into bloody icicles... and then you're the ones who show up instead.

771150612.text: Least I can still go squeeze him for that hundred-times breach of contract fee he owes me. Otherwise, this whole thing would be a total bust!

771150613.text: A penalty of 100 times? That seems a bit much.

771150615.text: And so what if it's daylight robbery?

771150616.text: Look, I didn't mean to... But it's not like I got any other choice. Lookin' for loot in Okurov? That's risky business, man.

771150617.text: Though we didn't run into that giant firebird everyone's been yappin' about, we still near about kicked the bucket tryin' to haul out... that super rare treasure.

771150618.text: And now that all that loot ain't mine anymore, I gotta find a way to make sure I don't lose my shirt at least...

771150619.text: #Hey! Robbery is wrong no matter what your reasons are! If it weren't for the fact that {NICKNAME} knows how to fight...

771150622.text: I won't do it again... I swear, from here on out, I'm making myself scarce, and you ain't ever gonna see my face again...

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to location near where the stash is
Clear the obstacle blocking the tunnel entrance
Explore the space holding the stash inside the tunnel

771151401.text: #Whoa... {NICKNAME}, is that a little girl...? With tree branches growing out of her head!? That has to be some kind of decoration... right? Nobody actually has branches growing out of their head like that!!!

771151402.text: I—Is she s-still alive? Is she the "live specimen" Paimon's been hearing about???

771151403.text: That "super rare treasure" The Anvil was talking about... could it be...?

771151404.text: *Sobs loudly* Please let me go... I don't have any treasure...

771151405.text: Ow! You gave Paimon a real scare there!

771151406.text: Calm down, Paimon. It's just a little girl.

771151407.text: Uhhh... sorry about that. Don't be scared — we won't hurt you! We're the ones who just freed you, actually.

771151408.text: Oh... I thought I was gonna get kidnapped again... Those Volkodlak! If Zala were here, she'd beat them up so bad, they'd turn into total dum-dum losers!

771151409.text: "Those Volkodlak"...? Are you talking about The Anvil and his men...? Anyway, don't worry, we've already taught them a lesson! But who is this <color=#00E1FFFF>"Zala"</color> you're talking about...?

771151410.text: Zala is family, and she watches over the town. Oh, I live in Okurov, but I have no idea where I am right now...

771151411.text: I've been away from home for a while... Mama must be crying... going rustle, rustle with her leaves...

771151412.text: #{NICKNAME}，Goggles' body might just be in that place! Eh... Oku... Okuro... Okuro-vuro!

771151414.text: Tsk, fine! Paimon can't remember the name of that town! But that's not the important thing right now!

771151415.text: The important thing is... since this little girl is heading back to town too, why don't we go together? She can show us the way!

771151419.text: #Ahem, tell you what. My name is Paimon, and this here is {NICKNAME}.{M#He}{F#She} is a super awesome adventurer. We were just on our way to the town to... Um... do some sightseeing!

771151420.text: How about we take you back to town?

771151421.text: Wow! Two awesome adventurers are gonna take me home? You two are so nice! My name is Nastya. Now we are friends, and very soon we will be family.

771151422.text: Hang on, hang on... isn't it a bit too soon for us to be "family"?

771151423.text: Heh, that's true. Plus, so much has to happen before we can become family anyway...

771151424.text: #{M#Big Brother}{F#Big Sister} {NICKNAME}, Paimonka, let's go back to town first! I can show you the way once we get there.

771151425.text: "Paimonka"? "Little Paimon"...? Huh. That sounds pretty weird... Nastya, you're not that much bigger than Paimon, you know! But at least it's not a horrible nickname...

771151426.text: Anyway, let your Best Travel Guide Ever over here figure out which way we need to go first!

771151427.text: Didn't that Anvil guy say this tunnel would take us to town? Then we should just follow the tracks! But... it looks like the way here is still blocked...

771151428.text: Oh? I know a way. But I need your help.

771151417.text: Right? Isn't tha—— Hey! That's not what Paimon was talking about, either! Stop cutting in like that!

771151418.text: What Paimon is saying is, since this little girl is heading back to town too, we can go together with her! She can show us the way!

subQuests.subQuestName: Open up the path to Ogurov
